query:
UPDATE rb_team_currency tc
            SET utime_at = NOW(), amount = LEAST(
                tc.amount + (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - tc.utime_at))::INT / 60) * (c.growth + tc.growth),
                c.max_amount
            ) - $3
            FROM rb_currency c
            WHERE tc.currency_id = c.id AND tc.team_id = $1 AND c.id = $2
                AND ($3 <= 0 OR LEAST(
                    tc.amount + (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - tc.utime_at))::INT / 60) * (c.growth + tc.growth),
                    c.max_amount
                ) >= $3);
